product: Lakebase Change Data Feed (CDF) is now in Public Preview
tagline: You can now store every insert, update, and delete on your Lakebase Postgres tables as Unity Catalog managed Delta tables.
what_it_does: You can now store every insert, update, and delete on your Lakebase Postgres tables as Unity Catalog managed Delta tables. Lakebase Change Data Feed (CDF) captures row level changes from the write ahead log for downstream pipelines, models, and audit, with no external CDC stack to run. note The Lakebase Change Data Feed feature is in Public Preview.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
